charAlmaProfile: A silver-haired swordfighter who fights with a slender rapier. Each thrust is light, but faster than anyone else's, and never off the mark.
charLapisProfile: A silver-haired mage who has been at your side since the journey began. She would rather not stand at the front, but she strikes precisely from afar and closes her allies' wounds.
charVermiliaProfile: A swordfighter with burning red hair. She swings a greatsword as tall as she is, and a single blow can turn a battle around.
skillAlmaPiercingThrustDesc: Deals damage to one adjacent enemy for a low AP cost.
skillAlmaSilverBannerDesc: Grants AP to one ally within 2 tiles and restores their HP.
skillVermiliaHeavyCleaveDesc: Deals massive damage to one adjacent enemy at a high AP cost.
skillVermiliaIronStanceDesc: Braces in place and restores her own HP.
skillLapisFrostBoltDesc: Deals damage to one enemy within 3 tiles.
skillLapisMendingLightDesc: Restores HP to one ally within 2 tiles.
